The '''Kashyyyk long-gun''',<ref name="Heroes">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050728a|text=Heroes of ''Revenge of the Sith''}}</ref> also known as '''Long-gun''',<ref name="VD" /> or simply as the '''Wookiee Blaster Rifle''',<ref name="BftG">''[[Star Wars: Battles for the Galaxy]]''</ref> was a model of [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] weapon. Used almost exclusively by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], the long-gun's [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] alloy [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] offered no scope or rangefinder, limiting the weapon to use in short-range combat. The weapon used a 10-shot ammunition clip, and each shot would incur a powerful recoil. The Wookiee leader [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] wielded a long-gun during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|defense]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]]. It weighed 8 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and cost 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
